## Notes


### Coordinator endpoint

This hob uses Miele's private Zigbee profile for live telemetry. Some adapters may require coordinator-side support for a Miele gateway endpoint before the hob starts reporting cooking-zone updates.

When the coordinator endpoint is available, the hob publishes per-zone state, power and mode, plus aggregate `hob_power` and `extractor_demand` values which can be used by MQTT automations, for example to control an extractor fan.
